lines: The wind agreed to stop. Your ears are truer than a bow.
The coast is still roaring. Whether you go is up to you.
Swiftshadow won't wait for a title. Its true body waits—for one short instant.
Don't chase the afterimages. Wait for the pause, then shoot. —Worth more than a pretty medal.
The forest knows the pause, not titles. Walking slow is good.
